crossReferences: Deuteronomy 5:27; Romans 1:5 ('the obedience of faith'); Hebrews 11:8 (Abraham obeying before knowing where he was going); John 7:17 ('If anyone's will is to do God's will, he will know whether the teaching is from God').
historicalTrivia: The Talmud (Shabbat 88a) records that at *na'asseh ve-nishma* ('we will do and hear'), 600,000 angels descended and placed two crowns on each Israelite — one for *na'asseh* and one for *nishma*!

dominicalIntent: And Moses took the blood and threw it on the people and said: 'Behold the blood of the covenant (*HINNEH DAM HA-BRITH*) that the Lord has made with you in accordance with all these words.' MOSES DASHES THE COVENANT BLOOD ON THE PEOPLE: 'BEHOLD THE BLOOD OF THE COVENANT!' THIS IS THE DIRECT OLD TESTAMENT TYPE OF JESUS' WORDS AT THE LAST SUPPER IN MATTHEW 26:28! **JESUS QUOTES EXODUS 24:8 DIRECTLY AT THE EUCHARIST!**
cccReferences: CCC 613 (The blood of the New Covenant poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins — Matt 26:28 citing Exod 24:8); CCC 1365 (The Eucharist as memorial and sacramental re-presentation of the Covenant blood); CCC 1340.
historicalContext: Moses dashing the blood on all the people creates a blood-bond between God and Israel: they share the same blood = they are one covenant family. THE MOST DRAMATIC ACT OF COVENANT RATIFICATION IN SCRIPTURE.
translationNuances: Hebrew *Vayyiqach Moshe eth-ha-dam vayyizroq al-ha-am vayyo'mer hinneh dam-ha-brith asher karath YHVH immakhem al kol-ha-ddevarim ha-elleh*: *hinneh dam-ha-brith* ('Behold the blood of the covenant!').
crossReferences: Matthew 26:28 ('This is my blood of the covenant / *to haima mou tēs diathēkēs* which is poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins'); Hebrews 9:19-20 ('Moses took the blood... and sprinkled both the book and all the people, saying, *This is the blood of the covenant*'); Mark 14:24.
historicalTrivia: Hebrews 9:20 quotes Exodus 24:8 VERBATIM as the type of Christ's Eucharistic words in Matthew 26:28 — establishing the direct typological chain: Moses's covenant blood → Jesus's Eucharistic cup. The Eucharist IS the covenant blood of a New Sinai!

dominicalIntent: Then Moses and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel went up... MOSES, AARON, NADAB, ABIHU AND THE 70 ELDERS ASCEND THE MOUNTAIN!
historicalContext: The 74 covenant representatives ascending the holy mountain for the covenantal theophany-banquet.
translationNuances: Hebrew *Vayyaal Moshe ve-Aaron Nadav va-Avihu ve-shivim mi-ziqney Yisra'el*.
crossReferences: Exodus 24:1; Numbers 11:16; Revelation 4:4 (24 elders around the throne — doubling the 12 tribes of Israel!).
historicalTrivia: Revelation 4:4's 24 elders around God's throne may be a doubling of the 12 elders representing 12 tribes (OT) + 12 apostles (NT) — all ascending to see God, fulfilling Exodus 24:9!

dominicalIntent: ...and they saw the God of Israel (*VA-YIRU ETH ELOHEY YISRA'EL*). There was under his feet as it were a pavement of sapphire stone (*LIVNATH HA-SAPPIR*), like the very heaven for clearness. THEY SAW THE GOD OF ISRAEL! THE SAPPHIRE PAVEMENT! 74 human beings see God standing on a radiant sapphire pavement (*livnath ha-sappir*) — dazzlingly blue-clear like heaven itself! A VISIONARY THEOPHANY OF STAGGERING MAJESTY!
cccReferences: CCC 2575 (Moses and the elders seeing God face-to-face — the anticipation of the beatific vision reserved for the righteous); CCC 1028 (The beatific vision as seeing God 'face to face' in eternity).
historicalContext: *Livnath ha-sappir* (sapphire/lapis lazuli pavement) — the radiant blue of the sky above — the divine platform of God's throne. Ezekiel and John will see the same sapphire/crystal in their visions!
translationNuances: Hebrew *Va-yiru eth Elohey Yisra'el ve-tachat raglav ke-ma'asseh livnath ha-ssappir u-khe-etzem ha-ssamayim la-tohar*: *livnath ha-ssappir* ('sapphire/lapis lazuli pavement'). *la-tohar* ('for clarity/purity').
crossReferences: Ezekiel 1:26 ('Above the expanse there was something like a sapphire throne, and seated above the likeness of a throne was a likeness with a human appearance'); Revelation 4:6 ('before the throne there was as it were a sea of glass, like crystal'); Ezekiel 10:1.
historicalTrivia: The sapphire (*sappir*) under God's feet appears AGAIN in Ezekiel 1:26 (the divine chariot-throne, *Merkavah*) and Revelation 4:6 (the crystal sea before the throne) — Sinai's theophany establishes the template for all subsequent heavenly throne visions!

dominicalIntent: And he did not lay his hand on the chief men of the people of Israel; they beheld God, and ate and drank (*VA-YECHZU ETH HA-ELOHIM VA-YOKHELU VA-YISHTU*). THEY BEHELD GOD AND ATE AND DRANK IN HIS PRESENCE! THE COVENANT MEAL IN THE DIVINE PRESENCE! 74 human beings see God directly and then eat and drink in His presence — **THE SACRAMENTAL COVENANT BANQUET PREFIGURING THE EUCHARISTIC FEAST!**
cccReferences: CCC 1094 (The covenant meal on Sinai prefigures the Eucharistic banquet where we eat and drink in the presence of the Risen Christ); CCC 1329 (The Eucharist as the supper of the Lord — the sacred meal in the divine presence).
historicalContext: The covenant banquet *in the presence of God* (*liphney ha-Elohim*) is the supreme Old Testament type of the Eucharist — eating and drinking in the presence of the God of the Covenant.
translationNuances: Hebrew *Ve-el-atzile bney Yisra'el lo shalach yado va-yechzu eth-ha-Elohim va-yokhelu va-yishtu*: *atzile* ('chief men/nobles'). *va-yechzu* ('they beheld/gazed' from *chazah* = prophetic seeing). *va-yokhelu va-yishtu* ('and they ate and drank').
crossReferences: Isaiah 25:6-8 ('On this mountain the LORD of hosts will make for all peoples a feast of rich food, a feast of well-aged wine...'); Luke 22:29-30 ('I assign to you a kingdom... that you may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom'); Revelation 19:9.
historicalTrivia: This is the ONLY place in the OT where humans eat and drink in God's visible presence — making it the supreme type of the Eucharist! The Eucharist is the New Covenant banquet on the New Sinai, fulfilling Exodus 24:11!

dominicalIntent: The Lord said to Moses: 'Come up to me on the mountain and wait there, that I may give you the tablets of stone (*LUCHOTH HA-EVEN*), with the law and the commandment, which I have written for their instruction.' YAHWEH CALLS MOSES TO RECEIVE THE STONE TABLETS (*LUCHOTH HA-EVEN*) WRITTEN BY GOD'S OWN FINGER!
cccReferences: CCC 2058 (The Decalogue written by God's own finger on stone tablets — divine inscription of the moral law); CCC 2056.
historicalContext: The two stone tablets (*luchoth*) inscribed by God's finger (*etzba Elohim*, Exod 31:18) on both sides — containing the Decalogue.
translationNuances: Hebrew *Vayyo'mer YHVH el-Moshe aleh elai ha-harah ve-heyeh-sham ve-etenah lekha eth-luchoth ha-aven ve-ha-torah ve-ha-mitzvah asher katavti le-horotham*: *luchoth ha-aven* ('tablets of stone'). *asher katavti* ('which I have written').
crossReferences: Exodus 31:18 ('God gave Moses the two tablets of the testimony, tablets of stone, written with the finger of God'); Deuteronomy 5:22; 2 Corinthians 3:3 (the New Law written not on stone but on hearts by the Spirit!).
historicalTrivia: 2 Corinthians 3:3 explicitly contrasts Sinai's stone tablets with the New Covenant: 'You are a letter from Christ... written not with ink but with the Spirit of the living God, not on tablets of stone but on tablets of human hearts'!

dominicalIntent: So Moses rose with his assistant Joshua, and Moses went up into the mountain of God. Moses takes Joshua (*Yehoshua* = Jesus!) as his personal aide for the 40-day ascent.
historicalContext: Joshua (*Yehoshua*) as Moses' personal aide (*mesharet*) accompanies him part way up the mountain while the elders wait below.
translationNuances: Hebrew *Vayyaqom Moshe vi-Yehoshua meshartho vayyaal Moshe el-har ha-Elohim*: *Yehoshua meshartho* ('Joshua his minister/aide' — same root as *sharath* = minister/serve, used for angelic ministers too).
crossReferences: Exodus 33:11; Numbers 11:28; Joshua 1:1 (Joshua takes over from Moses to lead Israel into the Promised Land).
historicalTrivia: Joshua (*Yehoshua* = Jesus!) as Moses' assistant is the direct type of Jesus succeeding Moses as Mediator — where Moses could only bring Israel to the edge of the Promised Land, Jesus (*Yehoshua*) brings them fully IN (Hebrews 4:8)!

dominicalIntent: And he said to the elders: 'Wait here for us until we return to you. And behold, Aaron and Hur are with you. Whoever has a dispute, let him go to them.' AARON AND HUR LEFT AS JUDGES IN MOSES' ABSENCE!
cccReferences: CCC 2575 (Delegated authority and shared governance); CCC 1547.
historicalContext: Aaron (High Priest) and Hur (of the tribe of Judah) left as joint rulers — prefiguring the Aaronic and Davidic dual offices.
translationNuances: Hebrew *Ve-el-ha-zqenim amar shivu-lanu vazzeh ad asher-nashuv aleykhem ve-hinneh Aaron ve-Chur immakhem mi-ba'al dvarim yiggash alehem*: *Chur* (Hur = of Judah, husband of Miriam according to Josephus).
crossReferences: Exodus 17:12 (Aaron and Hur previously supported Moses' arms in prayer); Exodus 31:2 (Bezalel son of Hur made the Tabernacle).
historicalTrivia: Hur is the grandfather of Bezalel (Exod 31:2; 35:30; 38:22) — the master craftsman who built the entire Tabernacle! Hur's lineage produced both the Covenant's guardian (Exod 17:12; 24:14) and the Tabernacle's builder!

dominicalIntent: Then Moses went up on the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain (*VA-YKHASS HA-ANAN ETH HA-HAR*). THE CLOUD COVERS SINAI! The divine Cloud (*anan*) — the manifest glory of Yahweh's presence — covers the entire mountain.
cccReferences: CCC 697 (The cloud as sign of the Holy Spirit's overshadowing presence — Sinai, Tabernacle, Temple, Transfiguration, Annunciation); CCC 2080.
historicalContext: The theophanic cloud (*anan*) — the same cloud that led Israel through the desert and rested on the Tabernacle.
translationNuances: Hebrew *Vayyaal Moshe el-ha-har va-ykhass ha-anan eth-ha-har*: *va-ykhass* ('and covered/concealed'). *ha-anan* ('the cloud').
crossReferences: Luke 9:34-35 (Transfiguration: 'A cloud came and overshadowed them... and a voice came out of the cloud'); Acts 1:9 ('A cloud took him out of their sight').
historicalTrivia: The same cloud that covered Sinai (Exod 24:15) covered the Tabernacle at its dedication (Exod 40:34), covered Jesus at the Transfiguration (Luke 9:34), and received Jesus at the Ascension (Acts 1:9)!

dominicalIntent: The glory of the Lord (*KAVOD YHVH*) dwelt on Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days. And on the seventh day he called to Moses out of the midst of the cloud. THE KAVOD OF YAHWEH DWELLS 6 DAYS; MOSES CALLED ON THE 7TH! The 7-day pattern mirrors the Creation Week — 6 days of waiting + the 7th day of divine speech. THE SINAI COVENANT AS NEW CREATION!
cccReferences: CCC 697 (The glory/Shekinah of Yahweh as the manifest divine presence); CCC 2080 (The Covenant established on the sabbatical 7th day).
historicalContext: The 6-day cloud + 7th day call mirrors the Creation Week of Genesis 1 — God is creating a new covenant order just as He created the cosmos in 7 days.
translationNuances: Hebrew *Vayyishkon kevod-YHVH al-har Sinai va-ykhasehu ha-anan shesheth yamim vayyiqra el-Moshe ba-yom ha-shvi'i mi-tokh ha-anan*: *kevod-YHVH* ('the glory of Yahweh' = the Shekinah). *ba-yom ha-shvi'i* ('on the seventh day').
crossReferences: Genesis 1-2 (7-day creation); Exodus 40:34-35 (Shekinah filling the completed Tabernacle); John 1:14 ('the Word became flesh and dwelt among us, and we have seen his glory/*doxa*').
historicalTrivia: John 1:14 uses *eskēnōsen* ('tabernacled/dwelt' from *skēnē* = tabernacle) and *doxa* ('glory') — directly echoing Exodus 24:16's *kavod* settling on Sinai! The Incarnation is the new Sinai where the *Kavod* dwells in human flesh!

dominicalIntent: Now the appearance of the glory of the Lord (*MAR'EH KEVOD YHVH*) was like a devouring fire (*ESH OKHELET*) on the top of the mountain in the sight of the people of Israel. THE DEVOURING FIRE (*ESH OKHELET*)! The *Kavod* (Glory) of Yahweh appearing as **DEVOURING FIRE** (*esh okhelet*) visible to all 2 million Israelites below — a terrifying cosmic display of the divine holiness!
cccReferences: CCC 696 (Fire as the supreme symbol of the Holy Spirit's transforming love; the *esh okhelet* on Sinai fulfilled in the tongues of fire at Pentecost); CCC 2110.
historicalContext: The *esh okhelet* (consuming fire) visible to all Israel — combining the terror of divine holiness with the warmth of divine love.
translationNuances: Hebrew *U-mar'eh kevod YHVH ke-esh okhelet be-rosh ha-har le-eyney bney Yisra'el*: *esh okhelet* ('devouring/consuming fire'). *le-eyney bney Yisra'el* ('in the eyes/sight of the children of Israel').
crossReferences: Hebrews 12:29 ('Our God is a consuming fire' — directly quoting this Sinai image); Acts 2:3 ('There appeared to them tongues as of fire'); Deuteronomy 4:24.
historicalTrivia: Hebrews 12:29 culminates its great contrast between Sinai and the heavenly Jerusalem by quoting Deuteronomy 4:24's echo of Exodus 24:17: 'For our God is a consuming fire (*esh okhelet*)' — the divine fire of Sinai burns in the eternal New Covenant!

dominicalIntent: Moses entered the cloud and went up on the mountain. And Moses was on the mountain forty days and forty nights (*ARBA'IM YOM VE-ARBA'IM LAILA*). MOSES IN THE CLOUD FOR 40 DAYS AND 40 NIGHTS! **THE SUPREME BIBLICAL PATTERN OF 40 DAYS IN THE DIVINE PRESENCE!** Moses' 40 days on Sinai is the supreme OT archetype, fulfilled by Elijah (1 Kings 19:8) and JESUS (Matthew 4:2)!
cccReferences: CCC 2575 (Moses' 40-day fast in the divine presence as the supreme Old Covenant prayer and contemplation); CCC 540 (Jesus' 40 days in the wilderness as the fulfillment of Moses' 40 days on Sinai — the New Moses recapitulating Israel's desert experience).
historicalContext: 40 days (*arba'im yom*) = the standard period of divine encounter and transformation in Scripture: Noah's flood, Moses (twice on Sinai), Elijah, and Jesus.
translationNuances: Hebrew *Vayyavo Moshe be-tokh ha-anan vayyaal el-ha-har vayyehi Moshe ba-har arba'im yom ve-arba'im laila*: *arba'im yom ve-arba'im laila* ('forty days and forty nights' — full, complete round numbers of intense experience).
crossReferences: 1 Kings 19:8 (Elijah's 40-day journey to Horeb/Sinai in the power of food!); Matthew 4:2 ('He fasted forty days and forty nights'); Deuteronomy 9:9,18,25; Deuteronomy 10:10.
historicalTrivia: JESUS fasts 40 days in the wilderness (Matt 4:2) IMMEDIATELY AFTER His Baptism — recapitulating Moses' 40 days on Sinai after crossing the Red Sea (= Baptism, 1 Cor 10:2)! Jesus is the New Moses receiving the New Law on the New Sinai!
